# Yundera/AppStore — Sonarr

**Audit date:** 2026-08-05 · **Store version (image):** `lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:4.0.17` · **Compose ref:** `main` · **Scope:** n-a (audit, no diff) · **Depth:** full

## Headline verdict: ERRORED — functional audit not runnable (infra) · top static severity Minor · risk_score 2

The **static** leaf ran to completion (no Critical/Major; 2 Minor). The **functional** leaf could **not be run at all**: every `✅ Ready` demo instance rejected every provisioned credential, so the CasaOS dashboard was unreachable and Sonarr was never installed. Per the Functional Review Protocol demo-host amendment (rule 4) and orchestrator Amendment §B4/§E, an infra-blocked run is **errored** (retry) — the app is not blamed. A missing/errored mandatory phase can never be `compliant`; because the block is infra (not an agent skip), the correct label is `errored`, not `non-compliant`.

---

## Functionality (Functional Review Protocol · 7HxjTwe63H) — NOT RUNNABLE (infra)

**Demo-host selection (amendment 2026-07-17):** Read the board at `https://app.nasselle.com/demo/admin/manage`. Both instances read `✅ Ready`: **demostaging1** (Time Remaining 22.0h) and **demostaging2** (14.0h). Per rule 3 I selected the Ready host with the most time remaining and >1h → **demostaging1.inojob.com**.

**Blocker — authentication impossible on every Ready host (both auth backends):**

| Attempt | Host | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Local Account (Authelia) `demo` / `demodemo` (task-provided) | demostaging1 | `POST /api/firstfactor` → **401** `status:KO` |
| Local Account (Authelia) `demo` / `demodemo` | demostaging2 | **401** `status:KO` |
| Local Account `demo@yundera.com` / `Demo123!` (portal-advertised) | both | **401** `status:KO` |
| Local Account other combos (`demo/Demo123!`, `admin@…`, `pcs/…`, etc.) | both | all **401** `status:KO` |
| Yundera Login (Firebase) `demo@yundera.com` / `Demo123!` (portal-advertised) | demostaging1 | `auth/invalid-credential` (rejected) |

The demo portal (`app.nasselle.com/demo/`) itself displays **App Credentials: **`demo@yundera.com`** / **`Demo123!`, and its embedded iframe carries no pre-provisioned dashboard session — it renders the same login gate. Every provisioned credential is rejected by **both** the Authelia local gate and the Firebase Yundera login, on **both** instances. The pool is therefore false-"Ready": the board shows a green check while the identity backend refuses the demo credentials. The CasaOS dashboard could not be reached, so the App Store modal, install, and all runtime checks were unreachable.

| Phase | Result | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A — Session | **errored** | Could not authenticate on demostaging1 or demostaging2 (Authelia 401 + Firebase invalid-credential) with any provisioned credential. |
| C — Fresh install (+duration) | **errored** | Unreachable — dashboard never loaded; Sonarr never installed; no install duration. |
| D — Discover URL | **errored** | Unreachable. |
| E8 — Works immediately | **errored** | Unreachable. |
| E9 — Auth gate | **errored** | Unreachable (this would have resolved the static auth-enforcement opinion above). |
| E10 — Clean boot (console/network) | **errored** | Unreachable. |
| F — Zero-config usability | **errored** | Unreachable. |
| G — Data persistence (uninstall-keep-data → reinstall) | **errored** | Unreachable. |
| G′ — Migration | n-a | No `PRIOR_VERSION` supplied (audit runs a single current version). |

**Host used / traceability:** selected demostaging1.inojob.com (22.0h remaining); cross-checked demostaging2.inojob.com (14.0h). `🧹 Trigger Cleanup` was never clicked.

## Cleanup

No app was installed (dashboard unreachable), so there was nothing to uninstall. Both demo instances are left exactly as found. Cleanup obligation (§3 Phase H.15) satisfied trivially.

## Disposition

`errored` (retry) — infra, per orchestrator Amendment §E ("infra genuinely blocked a phase → ERRORED; the app is not blamed") and Functional amendment rule 4. The static leaf is clean apart from **2 Minor** findings (cpu_shares tier `10`; thumbnail == icon). Re-run once a demo instance accepts the provisioned credentials; the one item most worth confirming on retry is **Phase E9** (is Sonarr's built-in auth enforced by default on the public endpoint) — the only path by which this app could turn out non-compliant with a Critical.

### Static findings summary (risk_score = 1·2 = 2)

- **Minor** — `cpu_shares: 10` is the reserved System-Background tier; wrong for a user-facing interactive web UI (expect ~50/80).
- **Minor** — `thumbnail.png` is byte-identical to `icon.png` (no distinct tile image).
- **Advisory (unverified)** — no AppShield/OIDC sidecar and no `rationale.md`; relies on Sonarr v4's first-launch auth. Acceptable per CONTRIBUTING onboarding-auth exception **iff** enforced by default — must be confirmed by Phase E9 on retry.
